title: v0.99.90 — GSD Execution, Persistence & Campaign Reliability Isolation
description: Frozen from v0.99.87 W4. Concentrate effectful GSD work behind cohesive ports/executors and preserve campaign truth atomically. Findings MA-06–MA-08. Broad gates after W2 and W5.

waves.title: v0.99.90 W0 — Port inventory and composition root
waves.body:
## Goal
Inventory filesystem/git/GitHub/clock/process/event effects; define small cohesive ports and one composition root.

## Gate
DI/contracts + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
At most one port per coherent external domain, tested with real fakes.

waves.title: v0.99.90 W1 — Campaign repository boundary
waves.body:
## Goal
Encapsulate campaign .rktd persistence/migration and fail closed on schema/fencing/plan/attempt identity.

## Gate
Persistence + Security + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Legacy fixtures load compatibly; corruption and containment checks fail closed.

waves.title: v0.99.90 W2 — Atomic projection transaction
waves.body:
## Goal
Treat campaign record and PLAN/STATE/VALIDATION/Wave projections as one logical atomic operation.

## Gate
Broad + Governance + failure injection + review.

## Acceptance
Crash at every write recovers idempotently without invented DONE or skipped wave.

waves.title: v0.99.90 W3 — Wave executor isolation
waves.body:
## Goal
Put tool/subagent execution behind an executor port with explicit cancellation, timeout, interrupt, and terminal outcomes.

## Gate
Executor/orchestrator + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Deterministic fakes, pending-tool cancellation, and exactly-once completion pass.

waves.title: v0.99.90 W4 — GitHub/release side-effect adapter
waves.body:
## Goal
Model board/issue/PR/release operations as idempotent correlated commands; dry-run default.

## Gate
Adapter contracts + Security + Workflow + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Retries create no duplicate external effect; SHA assertions and redaction hold.

waves.title: v0.99.90 W5 — End-to-end recovery and release
waves.body:
## Goal
Exercise campaigns through success/failure/interruption/restart and every persisted transition; publish v0.99.90.

## Gate
Broad + Arch + Security + Workflow + Smoke + Release + independent review.

## Acceptance
Truth equals projections after every interruption; no duplicate effect; all Golden Traces green.
